environmentVariables.description: Base URL of a self-hosted LiveVariant deployment. Omit to use the hosted service at https://livevariant.com.

environmentVariables.description: Asset upload token for a deployment with hosted images enabled. Optional.
environmentVariables.name: LIVEVARIANT_ASSET_UPLOAD_TOKEN
